items.title: 25.3 Dawa ki masnoaat ki synthesis (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the synthesis of pharmaceutical products (PDF 139-141).

blocks.text: Retrosynthesis ka ahem tareen istemal dawa ki masnoaat banane mein hai. Bohat si qeemti dawaiyon ki banawat pecheeda hai, lekin agar inhein durust aur mo'assar tareeqe se disconnect kiya jaye to yeh bohat saada, aam shuruati maaddon tak le jati hain.

items: Amide ka C-N bond torein: synthons HO-C6H4-NH- aur CH3CO+ hain.
Synthetic equivalents: 4-aminophenol aur ethanoyl (acyl) chloride; yeh nucleophilic addition-elimination se react karne ke liye maloom hain.
FGI: 4-aminophenol 4-nitrophenol se aata hai, jo aasani se banta aur reduce ho sakta hai.
4-nitrophenol ka C-N bond torein: synthons 4-hydroxyphenyl anion aur NO2+ hain.
Synthetic equivalents: phenol aur nitric acid.

blocks.text: Synthesis: phenol ki nitration se 4-nitrophenol (HNO3), nitro group ko Sn aur HCl se reduce kar ke 4-aminophenol, aur yeh ethanoyl chloride se react kar ke paracetamol, HO-C6H4-NHCOCH3, deta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: paracetamol ki retrosynthesis ke paanch qadam, amide C-N disconnection se phenol aur nitric acid tak. Neeche: phenol HNO3/H2SO4 se 4-nitrophenol, Sn + HCl se 4-aminophenol, aur CH3COCl se paracetamol, HO-C6H4-NHCOCH3.
blocks.caption: Paracetamol ki retrosynthesis aur synthesis (kitab ke khaakon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Peeche ki taraf chalte hue paracetamol ko amide bond par tora jata, amine ko nitro compound aur nitro compound ko phenol tak le jaya jata hai. Aage ki taraf pichhle chapters ke teen reactions, nitration, reduction aur acylation, phenol ko paracetamol mein badalte hain.

items: Ester ka C-O bond torein: synthons 2-carboxyphenoxide ion aur CH3CO+ hain.
Synthetic equivalents: salicylic acid (2-hydroxybenzoic acid) aur ethanoic (acetic) anhydride.
Salicylic acid ke carboxyl group ka C-C bond torein: synthons 2-hydroxyphenyl anion aur +COOH hain.
Synthetic equivalents: phenol aur carbon dioxide.

blocks.text: Synthesis: phenol zyada darja hararat aur pressure par carbon dioxide se react karta, aur H2SO4 se tezaabi karne par salicylic acid milta; salicylic acid ko ethanoic anhydride aur H3PO4 catalyst ke saath garam karne se aspirin (aur ethanoic acid) banta hai. Amalan pehla qadam sodium phenoxide se kiya jata hai, jo phenol aur sodium hydroxide se banta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: aspirin ki retrosynthesis ke chaar qadam, ester C-O disconnection se salicylic acid aur ethanoic anhydride, phir C-C disconnection se phenol aur carbon dioxide. Neeche: phenol (i) zyada darje aur pressure par CO2 aur (ii) H2SO4 se salicylic acid; (CH3CO)2O, H3PO4 aur garmi se aspirin.
blocks.caption: Aspirin ki retrosynthesis aur synthesis (kitab ke khaakon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Aspirin salicylic acid ka ester hai. Ester torne se salicylic acid milta, aur us ka carboxyl group torne se phenol aur CO2. Aage ki simt mein phenol ke ring par CO2 lagta, phir salicylic acid ka OH group ethanoic anhydride se acetylate hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Aspirin aur paracetamol dono phenol se bante hain. Un mein functional groups ka kul farq kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Aspirin ke ring par carboxylic acid group aur ester group (OCOCH3) hain; paracetamol mein phenol -OH group aur amide group (NHCOCH3) hain.

blocks.prompt: In ki synthesis mein kaun sa FGI shamil hai?
blocks.explanation: Paracetamol: 4-nitrophenol ka nitro group amino group mein reduce hota (NO2 -> NH2). Aspirin: phenol ka -OH acylation se ester mein badalta (OH -> OCOCH3).

blocks.prompt: Dono tayyariyon mein kaun sa synthon mushtarka hai? Is ki banawat aur aam synthetic equivalent batayein.
blocks.explanation: Acylium (acetyl) cation, CH3CO+; is ka synthetic equivalent ethanoyl chloride, CH3COCl (ya ethanoic anhydride, (CH3CO)2O, jaisa aspirin ke liye).
